title: Archival editor configuration
description: Per-object configuration for the archival editor, read from archival_editor.toml at the site root. Keys are object names from archival_objects.toml, except `shortcuts` and `activitypub`, which are reserved.

shortcuts.description: the entries offered by the editor's shortcut button, each creating a draft in one list. Reserved: an object of this name cannot be configured here.

objectConfig.description: configuration for a list of objects: either a top-level object list, or a list of children at any depth below one

views.description: the views available for this list in the editor. The first view is used by default.

children.description: configuration for child lists of this object, keyed by child field name. Nests indefinitely.

name.description: the name of this view, shown to editors when switching views

primary.description: the field shown as this view's primary content

secondary.description: an optional field shown as this view's secondary content

tertiary.description: an optional field shown as this view's tertiary content

shortcutConfig.description: a shortcut offered by the editor's shortcut button: the list a new entry is created in, and what to call it

name.description: the label shown on this shortcut. Defaults to the last name in `path`.

path.description: the list an entry created here joins, written as dot separated names: an object name from archival_objects.toml, then that object's filename where the object is a list rather than a single file, then the child field names leading down to the list, with an index wherever the route passes through one.

activityPubConfig.description: publishes the site over ActivityPub, so it can be followed from Mastodon and other fediverse servers. Every mapping names a field of the object it reads from. Reserved: an object of this name cannot be configured here.

username.description: the local part of the site's handle, `@<username>@<domain>`: letters, numbers and underscores, with dots and dashes allowed between them, up to 64 characters

objects.description: the lists published, keyed by the name of a list object from archival_objects.toml. Every instance of each list is published as its own post.

activityPubActorConfig.description: the profile other servers show for the site, read from a root object

object.description: the root object the profile is read from: a single object from archival_objects.toml, not a list

name.description: the string, markdown or enum field shown as the profile's display name

summary.description: the string, markdown or enum field shown as the profile's bio

icon.description: the image field shown as the profile's avatar

image.description: the image field shown as the profile's header

activityPubObjectConfig.description: how each instance of a list object is published

type.description: the ActivityPub object type each instance is published as

name.description: the string, markdown or enum field published as each post's title

summary.description: the string, markdown or enum field published as each post's summary, which Mastodon shows as a content warning over the post

content.description: the string, markdown or enum field published as each post's body

published.description: the date field published as when each post was first published

updated.description: the date field published as when each post was last updated

image.description: the image field attached to each post
